nodes.relation: H110 supplies the invariant format demanded by H035: a computable potential, an exact per-step bound, and a superpolynomial endpoint gap, while H105 contributes the discipline of an explicit model-preserving transfer.
H111 separates endpoint construction from the universal one-step inequality and demands transparent equivalence plus gap amplification from a fixed gadget.
H112 drops certified false positives entirely; every error certificate is just a satisfying assignment, so the remaining obstacle is uniform one-sided diagonalization rather than UNSAT certification.
H113 narrows H056 to a one-sided decoder and makes preservation of the SAT witness an explicit invariant of the reduction.
H114 selects the concrete lower-bound object missing from H106: opposite-label formulas that no fixed-radius ancestry map can distinguish locally.
H115 separates construction of hard local twins from the semantic theorem that low-treewidth output plus local recovery cannot distinguish them.

design_rule: C015 contains three funnels only: rewrite distance to EF lower bounds, one-sided SAT anti-checkers to circuit lower bounds, and local indistinguishability to compiler impossibility.
